title: WebGPU PBR in Rust: GGX Metallic-Roughness Grid
description: Explore basic WebGPU PBR in Rust with wgpu: 49 instanced spheres compare metallic and roughness using GGX, Schlick Fresnel, and four lights.
imageAlt: A perspective 7 by 7 grid of gold spheres showing metallic and roughness changes under bright point-light highlights.
